name: Property Change Ledger
changes: The Property Change Ledger notice for a Pro feature now has a Sponsor on GitHub button.
tip: Run Show recent property changes and set the key filter, such as status, to review one property across your notes.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Property Change Ledger is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to keep a history of your property changes.
